Image # EYE Sport presents the new FC Crotone 2026/27 Home Jersey 24.08.2026 EYE Sport presents the new FC Crotone Home Match Jersey for the 2026/27 season, a project born from the meeting of the club’s red-and-blue identity, its territory and its history, transforming some of the most representative elements of the city of Crotone into a contemporary graphic language. The concept of the new jersey looks to Magna Graecia and finds its main source of inspiration in the only remaining standing column of the ancient Temple of Hera Lacinia. Its silhouette is graphically reinterpreted and becomes an integral part of the jersey’s structure, helping to define the two large vertical stripes that characterize the front. The story of the territory continues on the sleeves, where a geometric pattern inspired by the Pythagorean Theorem introduces a further reference to the city’s cultural history. A motif specifically developed for the project, interpreting Pythagoras and his connection with Crotone in a contemporary way — the city where the philosopher and mathematician founded his famous school. Every detail of the jersey has been designed to strengthen its distinctive identity. Inside the collar, the phrase “Ma il cielo è sempre più blu” (“But the sky is always bluer”) appears, while the inside of the hem features a repeated F.C. Crotone inscription. From a technical standpoint, the new Home Jersey is entirely sublimated. The complete graphic design is transferred directly onto the fabric, allowing the colours, stripes and patterns to be perfectly integrated without surface applications. This solution ensures lightness, freedom of movement and excellent graphic durability over time. The jersey is made from 100% certified Repreve recycled polyester, designed to provide comfort and breathability during sporting activity. Ribbed fabric completes the construction of the collar and armholes. On the front, on the heart side, the FC Crotone crest is made of TPU, while the EYE Sport logo on the right side is made of silicone, adding a distinctive three-dimensional element to the jersey. Finally, a TPU QR Code on the right side provides direct access to the official EYE Sport page dedicated to FC Crotone. The new FC Crotone 2026/27 Home Jersey is an official EYE Sport product, entirely manufactured at the company’s facility in Cagliari.
